system_thesis_interpretation: V2e is a conditional interface calibration over exactly six named aligned-skin development lives: seeds 0, 1, and 2 with both collision twins. It is not a sample from a population. A physically shared provisional recurrent prefix produces MEMORY_0, and a fresh terminal-justified THINK_0 either emits the exact public-probe q_own coordinate or leaves that life PRIMARY_UNDEFINED. A defined life additionally requires at least sixteen distinct complete candidates for target-blind no-feedback, q-own, and the frozen same-life q-dist selector. Trusted code uses the coordinate only to allocate sixteen later public views; isolated calls to the same clean base model append provisional local-connection proposals. The two primary within-life descriptions are q-own allocation minus exact target-blind no-feedback and q-own allocation minus fixed distractor allocation, under frozen logical seeds and with every arm and control scored against identical q_own. Conditioning on definition, using named cases, and observing provisional closure prevent population, learning, memory, discovery, or autonomous-system interpretations.
